supersedes: s5-zero-shot-calibration-v2 for C2.1 (owner decision S5-1, 2026-10-29: 'Go UPAR route for now'; option C+D). v2 stays committed and unrun; no label was ever made for it.
frozen: 2026-10-30, committed before any UPAR tuning run
profile: src/vision/config/attributes/development-attributes-siglip2-zero-shot-v1.json (prompts as committed with this protocol; only the thresholds change after the run)

persons.data: UPAR-Challenge-2027 Task-1 annotations (release upar-challenge-2027-a19ab2fb, CC BY-NC-SA 3.0 DE) over PA-100K images (release pa-100k-2017, CC BY 4.0), read in place from E:/MAVI-Controlled/SourceMedia/S2c/2026-01/datasets/; images are read from the pinned data.zip in memory and never written elsewhere; no external service touches any image
persons.scope: owner scope extension from 'evaluate' to 'tuning' recorded in E:/MAVI-Controlled/Evidence/S5/2026-10-29-owner-tuning-scope-extension.json; Development-scope calibration of four abstention thresholds only, never a qualification
persons.eligibility: PA-100K images with a UPAR Task-1 row and shorter side >= 80 px (the runtime's minimumCropSide; a smaller crop scores zero and is always Unknown)
persons.tuningSplit: official PA-100K train images labelled by UPAR train/gt.csv
persons.heldSplit: official PA-100K test images labelled by UPAR val/gt.csv
persons.disjointness: image-disjoint by construction (different official splits); PA-100K publishes no identity, tracklet or scene ids, so identity/scene disjointness is not guaranteed and is not claimed
persons.sample: seed 202610305; 1500 eligible images drawn uniformly from each split

mapping.person-upper-colour: UPAR UpperBody-Color-{Black,Blue,Brown,Green,Grey,Orange,Pink,Purple,Red,White,Yellow} -> the same-named schema value when exactly one of the eleven is 1 and UpperBody-Color-Other is 0; otherwise unscorable (Other, several colours or none)
mapping.person-carried-bag: present when Accessory-Backpack or Accessory-Bag is 1, otherwise absent
mapping.person-headwear: present when Accessory-Hat is 1, otherwise absent
mapping.source: tools/qualification/attributes/datasets/data/mappings/upar-task1-person-colour-v1.json for the colour columns (adapter upar-task1); the presence rules are stated here

persons.trackLevel: a PA-100K image is one crop; it is scored as a one-crop Track through the runtime's own decision (abstention_score per crop, aggregate_track mean-score-argmax at 0.5, via track_decision). Multi-crop Tracks are not represented by this data
persons.rule: per person attribute, the smallest grid threshold whose tuning-split precision (correct Observed / Observed; an Observed decision on an image labelled unscorable or absent counts as wrong) is >= targetPrecision with >= minimumObserved Observed; if none, fallbackThreshold
persons.reported: for the chosen threshold, held-split precision with a Wilson 95% interval and coverage (Observed / eligible images), plus the eligible share of each split; thresholds are never re-chosen on the held split

vehicles.rule: predeclared and uncalibrated: vehicle-colour is Observed only when the Track's mean abstention-normalised score of the top colour reaches 0.5 with threshold 0.5, i.e. for a one-crop Track the top colour holds at least half of the softmax mass over the eleven colours; crops under 80 px score zero
vehicles.declared: threshold 0.5 committed in d6262172 (parameters-siglip2-zero-shot-v1.json) before any demo-corpus run; not tuned on any data and not changed by this protocol
vehicles.disclosure: uncalibrated; stated on the known-limits page and the register row
